Complaint Description: The Wi-Fi connection in the computer lab frequently disconnects during practical sessions. This interrupts online research, software downloads, and submission of lab work. Please check the access points and improve network stability.

The assigned lecture room does not have enough functional chairs for the enrolled students. Some students have to stand or share seating during lectures. Please arrange additional chairs and ensure adequate seating.

Several computers in the BSCS lab take a long time to start and frequently freeze while running programming tools. This reduces practical working time. Please inspect the systems and upgrade or maintain them.
The projector in our classroom displays a dim and unclear image, making lecture slides difficult to read from the back rows. Please repair or replace the projector and check its connections.
Power interruptions occur during computer lab sessions and cause students to lose unsaved work. Please inspect the electrical supply and consider backup power for the laboratory.

The student washrooms near the academic block are not being cleaned regularly and often lack basic supplies. This creates an unpleasant and unhygienic environment. Please arrange regular cleaning and replenishment.

The library has limited available seats during peak study hours, making it difficult to prepare for quizzes and assignments. Please consider adding study desks or extending access to another study area.

Complaint Title: Delay in Student ID Card Processing
Complaint Description: My student ID card request has not been processed despite submission of the required information. The delay creates difficulties when accessing university facilities. Please check the application and advise when the card will be issued.
Several ceiling fans in the classroom are not working, making it uncomfortable to attend long lectures, especially in warm weather. Please repair the fans and check the room ventilation.

Internet speed in the academic block becomes extremely slow during class hours. Students cannot reliably access learning resources or upload assignments. Please investigate bandwidth and network coverage.
The computers in the programming lab do not have the required updated versions of development software for current coursework. Please install and configure the necessary tools on all lab systems.
The classroom whiteboard surface is damaged and markers do not write clearly on it. This affects explanations during lectures. Please repair or replace the board and provide usable markers.
The drinking water cooler near the department is not cooling water properly. Students need access to safe drinking water on campus. Please inspect the cooler and arrange repair or replacement.

The library does not have sufficient copies of recommended BSCS textbooks for several courses. Students have difficulty preparing for coursework. Please review the course reading lists and add the required books.

The timetable displayed outside the department appears outdated and does not reflect the latest class changes. This causes confusion about room and lecture timings. Please update the notice and online timetable.
Some electrical sockets in the computer lab are loose or not functioning. Students cannot safely connect required devices. Please have qualified maintenance staff inspect and repair the sockets.
Several lights in our classroom are not working, leaving parts of the room poorly lit during lectures. Please replace faulty lights and ensure the classroom has adequate lighting.

Students experience long queues at the fee office, especially near payment deadlines. This results in missed classes and delays. Please consider improving counter management or providing a clearer token system.

The university student portal frequently rejects valid login details or times out while students try to access academic information. Please investigate the authentication issue and improve portal reliability.
The area around the drinking water point is often wet and dirty, and the surrounding drainage appears blocked. Please clean the area, inspect drainage, and maintain hygienic conditions.

The number of working computers in the BSCS laboratory is insufficient for the students attending practical classes. Some students have to wait to complete exercises. Please restore faulty machines or provide additional workstations.

Loud noise from nearby activities regularly interrupts lectures in our classroom. It is difficult to hear the instructor and concentrate. Please address the source of noise or provide a quieter teaching space.

The learning management system sometimes shows an error when uploading assignments, even when files meet the stated requirements. This risks late submissions. Please investigate the upload function and provide guidance for affected students.

The campus shuttle schedule does not align well with the end of afternoon classes, causing students to wait for extended periods. Please review the shuttle timings and consider an additional departure.
Several desks in the assigned classroom are broken or unstable and are uncomfortable to use for note-taking and examinations. Please repair or replace the damaged desks.
The library closes before many students can complete their study work after classes. Please consider extending opening hours during examination and assignment periods.
A request for an academic transcript has remained pending longer than expected, and no status update has been provided. Please review the request and communicate the expected processing date.

The computer laboratory becomes excessively warm during practical sessions because ventilation is inadequate. This affects comfort and concentration. Please inspect the fans or ventilation system and improve airflow.
Water accumulates near the entrance of the academic block after cleaning or rain, making the walkway difficult to use. Please clear the drainage and ensure the area is maintained safely.

Complaint Title: Noisy or Faulty Lab Keyboard and Mouse
Complaint Description: Some laboratory workstations have keyboards or mice that do not respond consistently. Students lose time troubleshooting peripherals instead of completing practical tasks. Please inspect and replace faulty accessories.
Two BSCS classes appear to be scheduled in overlapping time slots, creating uncertainty about attendance and room allocation. Please verify the department timetable and issue a corrected schedule.

Important academic notices on the department notice board are not being updated promptly. Students may miss deadlines or schedule changes. Please assign responsibility for regular updates and publish notices online as well.
Washroom taps and flush fittings in the student facility are damaged and need maintenance. Please repair the fittings and ensure routine inspections are carried out.

The classroom air conditioner makes excessive noise and does not cool the room consistently. This disrupts lectures and makes the room uncomfortable. Please arrange technical inspection and servicing.

Students are unable to access some subscribed online journals using the university library portal. These resources are needed for research assignments. Please verify access permissions and restore the e-resource links.

A correction requested for my academic record has not yet appeared in the student portal. Incorrect details may affect future university documentation. Please verify the submitted evidence and update the record.

The lights along the staircase leading to the academic rooms are not functioning properly, making the area difficult to use in the evening. Please repair the lights promptly to improve student safety.

Students have limited access to printing and photocopying facilities near the academic block, particularly when assignments are due. Please improve the availability or communicate alternative service arrangements.

The seating plan for an upcoming examination has not been displayed, leaving students uncertain about their assigned rooms. Please publish the seating arrangement in advance and ensure it is easy to access.
The wireless network signal in lecture rooms is weak, preventing students from accessing online course material during class. Please assess coverage and install or reposition access points as needed.
The student sports area has damaged equipment and an uneven playing surface. This limits safe participation in recreational activities. Please inspect the facility and arrange the necessary repairs.

My request for a bonafide certificate has not been completed within the expected time. I need the certificate for an official purpose. Please check the application status and advise when it can be collected.
